judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally sound and satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue, including accumulating usage across multiple tool rounds, ignoring rounds without usage, preserving the existing single-round test, and updating both the spec and CHANGELOG. For the signature requirement ('The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous'), the candidate renamed the parameter to `totalUsage` and also introduced a compatible type alias `AggregateUsage = UsageMetadata`, whereas the reference only renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. Compared to the reference, the candidate adds three new test/helper files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`, `chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts`, `orchestratorTestSupport.ts`) and `.lore/dod.md` rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` in place, and places the new `afterModelResponse` bullets in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving the behavior up to the main spec section.
